title: Open House — Sunday, July 26, 2:00–3:00 PM at the C26 Hub
body:
Join us **Sunday, July 26 from 2:00–3:00 PM** at the C26 Hub for an open
house for current and prospective C26 Aquatics families. Meet the coaching
staff, hear the vision behind the team, and get your questions answered —
kids are invited to swim while parents get informed (bring a suit, towel,
goggles, and a water bottle).

[View the full flyer for the schedule and RSVP code (PDF)](/open-house.pdf)
